mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollments (user_id, bootcamp_id, status, started_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bootcampId}, 'ongoing', CURDATE(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS enrollmentId, b.id AS bootcampId, b.name, b.organizer, e.status, e.started_at AS startedAt, e.ended_at AS endedAt FROM enrollments e JOIN bootcamps b ON e.bootcamp_id = b.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
SELECT bootcamp_id FROM enrollments WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
